module Cardano.Tx exposing (currentSlot, signedBy)

import Primitive exposing (..)
import Builtin exposing (..)
import Lift exposing (lower)

-- Test contexts encode the current slot and one signer as two Data fields.
currentSlot : Data -> int
currentSlot ctx =
    case ctx of
        Constr pair(_, [ I slot, _ ]) -> slot
        _ -> fail

signedBy : Data -> Bytes -> bool
signedBy ctx owner =
    case ctx of
        Constr pair(_, [ _, B signer ]) -> Builtin.equalsByteString signer (lower owner)
        _ -> fail
sources.Lift:
module Lift exposing (..)

import Primitive exposing (..)
import Builtin exposing (..)

trait Lift 'a 'b where
    lift : 'a -> 'b
    lower : 'b -> 'a

impl Lift int Int where
    lift value = Builtin.iData value
    lower value = Builtin.unIData value

impl Lift bytes Bytes where
    lift value = Builtin.bData value
    lower value = Builtin.unBData value
sources.Literal:
module Literal exposing (..)

import Primitive exposing (..)
import Builtin exposing (..)

trait FromInt 'a where
    fromInt : int -> 'a

trait FromString 'a where
    fromString : string -> 'a

trait FromBytes 'a where
    fromBytes : bytes -> 'a

impl FromInt int where
    fromInt x = x

impl FromString string where
    fromString x = x

impl FromBytes bytes where
    fromBytes x = x

trait FromBool 'a where
    fromBool : bool -> 'a

trait FromUnit 'a where
    fromUnit : unit -> 'a

impl FromBool bool where
    fromBool value = value

impl FromUnit unit where
    fromUnit value = value
sources.Logic:
module Logic exposing ( not, and, or, xor, (&&), (||) )


import Primitive
import Lift exposing ( Lift )


infix right 2 (||) = or


infix right 3 (&&) = and


{-| Negate a Big or little Boolean, returning bool. -}
not : Lift bool 'a => 'a -> bool
not value =
    if lower value then
        Primitive.False
    else
        Primitive.True


{-| Boolean conjunction. Fully applied calls short-circuit; partial and indirect calls are strict. -}
and : ( Lift bool 'a, Lift bool 'b ) => 'a -> 'b -> bool
and a b =
    if lower a then
        lower b
    else
        Primitive.False


{-| Boolean disjunction. Fully applied calls short-circuit; partial and indirect calls are strict. -}
or : ( Lift bool 'a, Lift bool 'b ) => 'a -> 'b -> bool
or a b =
    if lower a then
        Primitive.True
    else
        lower b


{-| Return True when the Boolean operands differ. -}
xor : ( Lift bool 'a, Lift bool 'b ) => 'a -> 'b -> bool
xor a b =
    if lower a then
        not b
    else
        lower b

module Workloads exposing (..)

import Primitive exposing (..)
import Builtin exposing (..)
import Literal exposing (..)
import Logic exposing (..)

sum : list int -> int
sum xs =
    case xs of
        [] -> 0
        x :: rest -> Builtin.addInteger x (sum rest)

listTraversal : int
listTraversal = sum [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8]

countdown : int -> int -> int
countdown n result =
    if Builtin.equalsInteger n 0 then
        result
    else
        countdown (Builtin.subtractInteger n 1) result

staticRecursion : int
staticRecursion = countdown 8 42

matchData : Data -> int
matchData value =
    case value of
        I n -> n
        _ -> 0

dataMatch : int
dataMatch = matchData (I 42)

dataMiss : int
dataMiss = matchData (B #"ab")

decode : Data -> int
decode value =
    case value of
        Constr pair(_, [I n, _]) -> n
        _ -> 0

decoding : int
decoding = decode (Builtin.constrData 0 [I 42, I 7])

validate : Data -> unit
validate value =
    case value of
        I n -> assert (Builtin.lessThanInteger 0 n)
        _ -> fail

validationPass : unit
validationPass = validate (I 42)

validationFail : unit
validationFail = validate (I 0)

booleanHelpers : bool
booleanHelpers = (True && False) || (True && True)

constantPrefixTwice : int
constantPrefixTwice =
    Builtin.addInteger (Builtin.subtractInteger 100 1) (Builtin.subtractInteger 100 2)

constantPrefixCold : int
constantPrefixCold =
    if True then
        42
    else
        Builtin.addInteger (Builtin.subtractInteger 100 1) (Builtin.subtractInteger 100 2)

prefixLoop : int -> int
prefixLoop n =
    if Builtin.equalsInteger n 0 then
        0
    else
        Builtin.addInteger
            (Builtin.addInteger (Builtin.subtractInteger 100 n) (Builtin.subtractInteger 100 n))
            (prefixLoop (Builtin.subtractInteger n 1))

constantPrefixLoop : int
constantPrefixLoop = prefixLoop 8
